name: Ollama + Open WebUI
description: Ollama local LLM runtime with Open WebUI, a ChatGPT-style browser interface for chatting with local models.

source.name: Open WebUI official documentation (Docker Compose with Ollama)

notes: No models are pulled automatically (they can be multiple GB). Open WebUI's first visitor becomes the local admin account — create it on first load. Pull a model from inside the container with `docker exec <ollama container> ollama pull llama3.2`, or from the Open WebUI Settings > Models screen.
